title: Caverns and Chasms Tin Spartan Weaponry and Shields
description: Does what it says on the tin: A Resource Pack that changes the coloring of the tin weapons and shields in Spartan Weaponry to match the tin ore in Caverns and Chasms (because it was driving me nuts)
body: Does what it says on the tin. Changes the coloring of the tin weapons and shields from Spartan Weaponry to match the color of tin from Caverns and Chasms (because that's the dominant version of tin I tend to have, and the color difference was driving me nuts)
